text:
Noah Cates is the kind of player who gets talked about in trade rumors because every contender wants one. A Yahoo Sports piece this month floated him as a middle-six target for Winnipeg if the Flyers sell. For now he is doing in Philadelphia what he does best: killing penalties and keeping the puck out of his own net.

He has 3 goals and 5 assists in 25 games at 13.6 minutes a night. Philadelphia gets 52% of the expected goals at five-on-five with him on, the share of chance quality, 10 points better than when he sits, one of the better relative numbers on the team.

Last season Evolving-Hockey ranked him 47th among 401 forwards, with most of his value from the penalty kill and opponents' chances suppressed in the 97th percentile. The same report says offense isn't his game, which matches what we see.

He should still have a bit more. His 4.25 expected goals have produced 3 goals, and the Flyers have scored 3.3 fewer goals than their chances deserve with him on. His ice time is up 1.4 minutes over his last ten games. If the Flyers keep winning, the trade talk probably fades.
headline: Doing the hard jobs
